subject: BrightPath: customer-specific disposition workflow & SIG artifacts request
messages:
From: Anika Bose <anika.bose@brightpathmed.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpathmed.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary log persistence & SIG/CAIQ artifacts for compliance review

Hi Markus,

Thanks for taking this. BrightPath is finalizing a regulatory checklist for an upcoming audit (state-level med device telemetry) and our audit team has flagged a need to retain session and debug traces for a small subset of tenants for 180 days (instead of standard 30 days).

Can Redwood confirm whether a customer-specific retention carveout is possible for a scoped tenant set (audit-only, non-prod traces excluded)? The audit team requests: 1) a signed attestation describing the retention change and proof-of-delete flow; 2) SIG spreadsheet export and CAIQ snippets that show log retention controls; and 3) any diagrams that describe how ephemeral KV cache and session logs are isolated and later deleted.

We understand this is an exception request and are prepared to include it in our procurement addendum. Can you let us know the evidence you can provide and an estimated turnaround? Procurement (procurement@brightpathmed.com) is copied on contract impact questions.

Thanks,
Anika Bose
Director, Regulatory Affairs
BrightPath Medical

Attachments: none
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Anika Bose <anika.bose@brightpathmed.com>, procurement@brightpathmed.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log persistence & SIG/CAIQ artifacts for compliance review

Hi Anika —

Appreciate the clear ask. Short answer: yes, we can support a scoped, customer-specific retention carveout with an attestation and a packaged evidence bundle. High-level approach and deliverables below so we can align on scope before we pull the artifacts: 

Scope options (you pick):
- Tenant-scoped debug/session traces for a named tenant list (recommended)
- Event-type scoped (only debugging traces, not PII-bearing application data)
- Timeboxed retention window (we propose 180 days as you requested)

Deliverables Redwood can provide:
1) Formal attestation letter (signed by our Security lead) describing the retention exception, retention window, and proof-of-delete procedures.
2) CAIQ/ SIG export (spreadsheet) with annotations calling out retention, logging, and deletion controls for the relevant controls.
3) A short architecture diagram (retention-process-diagram.png) showing how KV cache / ephemeral logs are isolated for the carveout and the deletion workflow (we'll include secured deletion logs).
4) Evidence index PDF that lists the artifacts and mapping to the appetite items your audit raised.

Pre-reqs from BrightPath:
- Confirm the exact tenant IDs or a sample list you want included.
- Confirm whether debug traces include any additional debug payloads (stack traces, full request bodies) so we can map scope.
- Signature party for the attestation (who at BrightPath will sign the addendum / acknowledge the carveout).

Timelines: once scope is confirmed, we can assemble the SIG/CAIQ export and the diagram within 5 business days; attestation + proof-of-delete package within 8 business days. If you need an expedited timeline we can prioritize but will surface a small professional services fee.

I've asked Ben (sales) and Marissa (compliance) to coordinate creation of the bundle and the attestation.

Best,
Markus Klein
Head of Enterprise Sales (Americas)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: retention-process-diagram.png (diagram, 240KB)
From: Anika Bose <anika.bose@brightpathmed.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightpathmed.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary log persistence & SIG/CAIQ artifacts for compliance review

Markus/Ben —

Thanks, that looks good. To confirm answers to your pre-reqs:
- Tenant list: we will provide three tenant IDs (BP-735, BP-892, BP-977) — these are test/telemetry tenants mapped to the audit scope.
- Payloads: debug traces will include anonymized request IDs and stack snippets; they do not include full patient-identifiable content.
- Signatory: I will be the signatory for BrightPath and procurement@brightpathmed.com will coordinate the addendum.

We can accept the 5/8 business day timeline. Procurement asked whether Redwood can include an export of the deletion logs that show the deletion job runs (for the proof-of-delete sequence) — specifically a sanitized audit trail showing the deletion invocation, job id, and completion timestamp. That should be sufficient for our auditors.

If you can draft the attestation language we will review it and prepare the addendum. Also please call out any residual risks and recommended compensating controls in the attestation (e.g., token revocation, short-term access approvals, and audit visibility).

Appreciate the quick reply.
Anika

Attachments: tenant-list-sample.csv (coming in separate procurement thread)

Markus / Marissa —

Recap + proposed internal owner breakdown: 
- Marissa: assemble SIG-v2026.xlsx with annotated CAIQ answers and pull sanitized deletion logs for the three tenant IDs (BP-735, BP-892, BP-977). Target: by EOD Thu 22 Jan.
- Marissa + Legal: draft the attestation letter and list residual risks + compensating controls. Target: draft by Tue 20 Jan.
- Markus: coordinate with procurement and get formal addendum signature; I will own the procurement thread.

Marissa — if the deletion logs need additional redaction, let me know early; blue team can run the scrub. Also flag any controls that aren't covered in the standard CAIQ export so we can call them out in the attestation.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if needed.
Ben Carter

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 21 Jan 2026 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Final: BrightPath SIG export, deletion logs (sanitized), and attestation draft

Hi Anika / procurement team —

Per our timeline, attached is the evidence bundle for BrightPath:
- SIG-v2026.xlsx (SIG spreadsheet export with annotations in column H calling out retention/deletion mappings)
- retention-process-diagram.png (visual of the carveout workflow)
- deletion-logs-sanitzed.csv (sanitized deletion audit entries: job_id, tenant_id, invocation_ts, completion_ts)
- evidence-bundle-index.pdf (index mapping artifacts to auditor questions)
- attestation-draft.docx (draft attestation language; signatory block for BrightPath and Redwood)

Notes / callouts:
- The deletion audit entries are redacted to remove requestor email and full request payloads; the job_id and timestamps are intact and can be used by your auditors to verify the sequence.
- Residual risk summary is in the attestation draft (section 3); recommended compensating controls include short-lived service tokens during the hold window, log access approvals, and an independent spot-check after deletion completes.
- If you want a notarized attestation we can escalate to legal for an executed letterhead version (add 3 business days).

Next steps we propose: BrightPath reviews attached attestation draft and confirms acceptance by Fri 23 Jan; procurement can then route the addendum for signatures. Once signed, we will schedule the deletion job to run against the three tenant IDs and will provide final proof-of-delete output within 48 hours of completion.

Links to artifacts (internal): https://drive.redwood.com/teams/compliance/brightpath/SIG-v2026.xlsx
DocuSign route created: https://docusign.com/brightpath/PROD-8942

Marissa Cole
